prompt:
Score each onboarding change. Sub-scores:
- impact 0-3: how many users the targeted step loses and how much this could recover
- evidence 0-3: whether the funnel and the support mail both point at this problem
- confidence 0-2: how likely this kind of change works, judged from the lessons below
- cost 0-2: 2 = config only, 0 = needs new screens and a release
Also give predicted_lift: expected relative change in the target step's conversion, e.g. 0.05.

Lessons from earlier weeks:
Predictions were generally too high in early tests, but winning new_flow changes were under-predicted.

Changes:
0: [finish, new_flow] Interactive Desktop Companion Calibration Flow: Inserts a desktop companion workspace calibration screen before final welcome to test pet screen placement and window collision. (why: Finish step has low conversion (64.8%) and users submitted support emails regarding pets not displaying properly on desktop screens.)
1: [choose_path, new_screen] Desktop Pet Companion Preview Screen: Adds a new pet preview screen immediately after story introduction to show live pet behaviors before path selection. (why: Choose_path step has high mean drop-off time (514s); providing an immediate preview sets expectations and motivates path selection.)
2: [sign_in, reorder] Deferred Sign-In After Adoption Selection: Reorders sign-in so that users select their pet companion choices before creating or linking their account. (why: Sign-in conversion drops to 72.9%; letting users pick their pet first increases investment before asking for login details.)
3: [home, notification] System Notification Desktop Visibility Check: Enables desktop ready notification switch and visibility check status while background assets prepare. (why: Waiting step takes a median of 201s (mean 2336s) and 3 support tickets reported pets failing to appear on desktop launch.)
4: [home, wait_info] Interactive Pet Readiness Progress Counter: Adds explicit step counter and progress bar to the waiting screen during pet rendering. (why: Waiting step takes mean 2336s; visual progress status reassures users during asset preparation.)
5: [choose_path, hint] Quick Path Selection Guidance Hint: Adds explicit guidance text hint on the story screen explaining path options upfront. (why: Choose path step takes mean 514s; providing early clarity reduces indecision before reaching the choice screen.)
6: [adoption, copy] Custom Pet Generation Quality Guidance Copy: Updates photo upload headline and body copy to specify clear photo requirements for AI pet generation. (why: Support received 3 emails about custom pet generation failing or looking wrong.)
7: [adoption, layout] Checklist Layout for Pet Creation Upload Screen: Switches the photo upload screen layout to a checklist format with visual verification points. (why: Support emails show bugs with custom pet generation; a structured checklist helps users upload high-quality source photos.)
